import heapq

def huffman_codes(freq):
    heap = [[f, i, ch, None, None] for i, (ch, f) in enumerate(freq.items())]
    heapq.heapify(heap)
    count = len(heap)
    while len(heap) > 1:
        lo = heapq.heappop(heap)
        hi = heapq.heappop(heap)
        heapq.heappush(heap, [lo[0] + hi[0], count, None, lo, hi])
        count += 1
    codes = {}
    def walk(node, code):
        if node[2] is not None:
            codes[node[2]] = code or "0"
            return
        walk(node[3], code + "0")
        walk(node[4], code + "1")
    walk(heap[0], "")
    return codes

freq = {'a': 5, 'b': 9, 'c': 12, 'd': 13, 'e': 16, 'f': 45}
print(huffman_codes(freq))
